text:
maya: Quick sync request — we need a firm embedding API contract + SLA bindings for tenant tiers. Customers asking for 8192 dims, variable-dim uploads, and higher per-request batching. Can we land on a ship-able MVP by EOW?

sam: high level constraints: serving runtime prefers fixed output dim per model to avoid re-quant/reshape costs. variable dims are doable but complicate kernel selection + cache. recommend uniform-dim responses per request.

oliver: ops note — memory + batching tradeoffs matter. For 8192 dims we hit memory cliffs on A100 80GB with batch > 64. We can do dynamic batching but need hard per-request cap. Propose per-request max 512 vectors for 8192, 2048 for 4096, unlimited (practical) for 1024.

liz: product ask — customers want simple client integration: a single endpoint that negotiates shape and returns metadata. Prefer payload that includes explicit "dimension" and a single flat array per item rather than nested maps.

maya: proposed schema (rough):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-v1",
  "dimension": 4096,
  "vectors": [[0.001, 0.23, ...], [0.12, -0.03, ...]],
  "warnings": ["truncated"],
  "billing_units": 32
}
```

toni: security/compliance check — for Private/Dedicated, we need clear SLAs mapping: per-tenant reserved throughput + burst policy. Also require per-request length limits to avoid DOS.

sam: prioritization: MVP (phase 1) = single canonical model per tenant with dims {1024, 4096} support, per-request batch cap 2048 for 1024 dims and 512 for 4096 dims, consistent response shape. Phase 2 adds 8192 and variable-dim negotiation.

oliver: implementation note — runtime needs an explicit header/param to pin model-dim, e.g., `X-Embed-Dim: 4096`. That avoids server side autodetect complexity.

liz: launch criteria proposal: (a) SDK + examples for batching and streaming, (b) stress tests showing p95 latency under SLA at worst-case dims, (c) migration path for customers on older vector shapes.

maya: customer asks triage — finance/legal wants clarity on billing_units for different dims & batching; growth wants opt-in beta for top 10 customers to validate 4096 perf before wide release.

sam: questions for product: do we expose multi-dim in one response (mixed dims across items)? that'd complicate downstream embeddings stores. my vote: no — require uniform dimension across a single request.

liz: agreed on uniform-dim per request. for migration, offer server-side pad/truncate helper in SDK so customers can send variable-length text and get back uniform-dim vectors.

maya: decision checkpoint: accept sam's constraint (uniform-dim per request) + oliver's per-dim batch caps. We will ship Phase 1 dims {1024, 4096}. Phase 2 will be 8192 after benchmarking + pricing model.

release-bot: canary pipeline queued for embedding-mvp-dims-1024-4096 — target window 2am UTC Friday.

toni: please add runbook entries for per-tenant throttles and billing calculations.

maya: thanks — i'll draft the spec doc with the schema above and the three-phase rollout plan. tagging @sam @oliver for implementation estimates by EOD. :thumbsup:

sam: will post rough ETA later today. :+1:
